title: peyotl zacatensis var. fricii
intro: Peyotl zacatensis var. fricii, commonly known as Lophophora fricii, is a rare and endangered succulent plant native to Mexico. This plant is a variant of the peyotl, a species of cactus known for its psychoactive properties, and is used in traditional medicine and rituals. The health benefits of Lophophora fricii include its potential to reduce pain, inflammation, and stress, as well as its ability to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as mescaline, peyotine, and 3-methoxy-4-hydroxyphenethylamine, among others.
